summary_en: Correction to board recommendation disclosure issued 1 June 2026 regarding Nice Corporation's tender offer for Yamadai. Financial figures in earnings announcement corrected from thousands to millions of yen (sales ¥4,102M, operating loss ¥286M, net loss ¥280M for FY3/26).
title_en: Correction Notice: Partial Amendment to Announcement of Board Recommendation Opinion and Solicitation of Acceptance Regarding Nice Corporation's Tender Offer for Yamadai Corporation Shares
translation_en_brief: This is a correction notice (訂正) issued by Yamadai Corporation on 2 June 2026 to amend a board recommendation disclosure published the previous day regarding Nice Corporation's tender offer for Yamadai shares. The correction addresses a unit conversion error in the attached announcement regarding the tender offer launch. In the FY3/26 earnings summary (2026 年３月期 決算短信), financial figures were incorrectly stated in thousands of yen (千円) when they should have been in millions of yen (百万円). The corrected figures are: sales ¥4,102 million (not thousand), operating loss ¥286 million, ordinary loss ¥263 million, and net loss attributable to parent company shareholders ¥280 million. Nice Corporation separately published a matching correction notice on the same date. The correction pertains to information deemed necessary for investors to evaluate whether to tender shares in the offer.
